description: Two ML/data science engineering students (Toulouse INP-ENSEEIHT & ENSIAS) building a health monitoring prototype for astronauts: anomaly detection on vital-sign time series, an LLM layer to explain alerts, and a live dashboard. Our stack: Python, deep learning, FastAPI, Docker. We’re looking for: data visualization/UX, space physiology or medicine knowledge, and a front-end dev. Trilingual team (FR/AR/EN). Goal: a working, deployed demo in 48h.
